correction: Believed coder.service stayed inert because ConditionFileNotEmpty=/etc/coder.d/coder.env fails until an admin configures it. The deb ships that file as a non-empty 291-byte template of empty key assignments, so the condition passes on every host and the server started with no CODER_ACCESS_URL. coder.service.d/10-snosi-configured.conf now gates the unit with ExecCondition=+/usr/lib/coder-sysext/coder-configured, which exits 0 only when CODER_ACCESS_URL has a value.
evidence: snosi#1117; /etc/coder.d/coder.env in coder_2.37.4_linux_amd64.deb (291 bytes, every key empty)
